standing_note: Classification is analysis, not execution. No proposition is canonized by appearing here. Rejected and bounded propositions remain Matter.

propositions.notes: Mirrors CLAIM !<= EVIDENCE in the type plane. Survives all 20 attacks; it is a type separation, not a behavioural claim.

propositions.statement: MEANING(S) IS NOT NECESSARILY INTRINSIC TO S
propositions.notes: Existential/modal form ('not necessarily'). Refutable only by exhibiting a system where meaning is always intrinsic. Attack 3 (stateless) shows such systems exist, which bounds the scope but does not refute the existential.
attacks_failed: A3 bounds: in a stateless system meaning IS intrinsic to S

propositions.notes: CC-04. Contradicts E-02 which adds C_t and H_t. Demote to restricted case with explicit assumption C,H subset-of X.

propositions.statement: SAME SIGNAL + DIFFERENT STATE MAY PRODUCE DIFFERENT RESPONSE
propositions.notes: Existential ('may'). Attack 1 (constant response) exhibits systems where it does not happen, bounding it to non-universal. Any reading of P-04 as universal is FALSE_BY_COUNTEREXAMPLE.

propositions.statement: NO COUPLING != MECHANICAL != STATE-DEPENDENT != ADAPTIVE != RESPONSE-FUNCTION MUTATION != RECURSIVE SELF-MODIFICATION
propositions.notes: CC-09. Levels 4-6 are not separable from black-box observation (F-02). Levels 0-3 ARE separable by intervention. Retain as model-internal taxonomy with observability caveat.
Instance of PROJECTION !<= STATE. Survives.

propositions.statement: STATE MORPH != INTERPRETATION MORPH != RESPONSE-FUNCTION MORPH != COUPLING MORPH
propositions.notes: F-02 and F-01. Real inside a model; NOT witnessable from trajectory data. I/F pair non-identifiable under any invertible reparameterization g: (I,F) ~ (g.I, F.g-inv). K/S also non-identifiable. Only STATE MORPH is even partly observable, and only up to the probe set (F-03).
attacks_failed: A10 - partial observability collapses I vs F and K vs S

propositions.statement: CHANGING THE SYSTEM != CHANGING HOW THE SYSTEM CAN CHANGE
propositions.notes: Well-formed given a meta-level. For a reflective system whose state IS its program the distinction collapses at the substrate level while remaining meaningful at the type level. Requires the type level to be declared, not assumed.
Four-stage separation matching the standing ladder. Survives all attacks.
Specimen M-02/M-03. Survives.

TRUE, and F-04: the two sides are jointly unobservable at every operating point. A is observable only where it binds; R_capability only where it does not. Supporting specimen (Antigravity) is founder testimony, epistemic_class CLAIMED - not inspected by this review.
Type separation between a measure and a permission. Survives.
Attack 15 (authorized-but-incapable) directly confirms. Refutes any model in which authority implies executability.
SELF-APPLYING: every law in this repository is declared and none is enforced. This review records itself as an instance.

propositions.statement: RAW WITNESS INTEGRITY != SEMANTIC WITNESS VALIDITY
propositions.notes: Attack 11 (adversarial observer) confirms: a byte-perfect log can attest a semantically invalid claim.
Attacks 12 and 13 establish both directions. method_validity and claim_validity are independent axes; both are carried in schemas/event.v1.yaml.
The most empirically robust item in the set - standard confounding. Specimen M-04 (right effect, wrong subject) is its institutional form.
Instance of PROJECTION !<= STATE. Survives.

propositions.statement: OBSERVABLE BY PROBE SET != ALL CURRENT STATE
propositions.notes: The partial-observability axiom. Everything in F-01/F-02/F-03 follows from it. Arguably the load-bearing proposition of the entire corpus.
Specimen M-07. Survives.

propositions.statement: CONTROL APPLIED AT t1 DOES NOT ESTABLISH CONTROL HELD FOR t < t1
propositions.notes: Temporal scoping. Survives. Strengthened by attack 6: under hysteresis, current occupancy carries no information about entry conditions.

propositions.statement: CONTAINMENT AFTER INITIALIZATION != CONTAINMENT OF INITIALIZATION
propositions.notes: Special case of P-21. Retain as an applied instance, not as an independent law.

propositions.statement: ENTRY CONDITION != PERSISTENCE CONDITION != EXIT CONDITION
propositions.notes: Attack 6 (hysteresis) does not merely fail to refute this - it makes it MANDATORY. Any state model storing a single predicate has already lost the distinction. Strongest confirmation in the review.
Survives.
Near-tautology given modal semantics. Survives trivially; low information content.

propositions.statement: PROJECTED EFFECT TOPOLOGY != OBSERVED EFFECT TOPOLOGY
propositions.notes: CC-06. The claim is sound; the word 'topology' is not. No open sets, neighbourhood system, or continuity claim is present. The object is a reachability set / effect dependency graph. Rename or mark metaphorical.

Attack 18 (response without learning) separates these OBSERVABLY: a system whose response distribution is invariant across a growing history is accumulating without learning. This joint survives identifiability.

Attack 19. NOT separable black-box: parameter adaptation inside a fixed F is indistinguishable from a change of F. Depends entirely on where the model draws the F/X boundary, which is a modelling choice, not an observation.
attacks_failed: A19 - F/X boundary is a modelling choice

propositions.notes: Attack 20. Requires the governed mechanism M to be a declared, inspectable object. Unwitnessable black-box.
The one joint in the ladder that is NOT an identifiability problem: authorization is an institutional record, checkable independently of behaviour. This is the ladder's strongest rung.
Duplicate of P-14. Merge.
Exactly the semantic type plane. Fully compatible with SELF-SCHEMA-01K3MSEMANTICTYPES00000000.
PROJECTION !<= STATE. Survives.
Important guard against over-correction. A doctrine that only forbids promotion tends to drift into discarding projections entirely. This blocks that drift.

propositions.statement: MACHINE NON-OBSERVATION DOES NOT FALSIFY A HUMAN OBSERVATION UNLESS THE MACHINE MODALITY HAD OBSERVABILITY OVER THE ASSERTED PROPOSITION
propositions.notes: A modal statement about observability scope, correctly quantified. Attack 16 confirms. This review is itself an instance: it did not observe SELFPI, so its silence about SELFPI falsifies nothing.

propositions.statement: BOUND FUTURE EFFECTS DOES NOT ERASE PRIOR PROCESS KNOWLEDGE
propositions.notes: Survives. Instance of P-20.

propositions.statement: SAME UI THRESHOLD != SAME RUNTIME STATE
propositions.notes: Applied instance of P-18 + P-19.
Applied instance of P-18. Merge into P-18 with an example.

propositions.statement: AUTHENTICATION STATE CHANGE MAY ALTER BACKGROUND BEHAVIOR
propositions.notes: Existential and system-specific. Not testable without naming the system, the auth transition, and the probe set. As written it is a heuristic, not a proposition.

propositions.statement: DISCOVERY THROUGHPUT > INSTITUTIONALIZATION THROUGHPUT IS A POSSIBLE GOVERNANCE BACKPRESSURE CONDITION, NOT YET A UNIVERSAL LAW
propositions.notes: Correctly self-limited ('not yet a universal law') - credit for that. But as an inequality it is dimensionally undefined: the units of discovery/time and institutionalization/time are unestablished, and comparison requires that each discovery consume exactly one institutionalization act. Currently directional guidance, not a measurable bound. Observed this session: 3 commands arrived while 1 was being institutionalized.

summary.load_bearing: P-19 (partial observability). F-01, F-02 and F-03 are all consequences of it.
summary.strongest_confirmation: P-23 (entry != persistence != exit), made mandatory by the hysteresis attack.
